name: spectral-gate
description:
A noise gate in every bin.

Each bin opens when its own level passes the threshold and closes when it
falls back, so hiss between the partials of a note is removed while the
partials pass.  The gain of each bin is smoothed over time (bin_smooth),
which is what keeps a gate like this from chirping.

spectrograms.label: Chirp (0 Hz → Nyquist over 5 s → decay)
